items.title: FLAKY under load — `fs::a_temporary_handle_releases_its_descriptor_at_its_statements_end` reads `/proc/self/fd` IMMEDIATELY after a statement whose temporary handle closes fire-and-forget (P10's instrument, deliberately unpolled so node's finalizer cannot mask a LEAK): it passed on CI run 35787009588 and locally 3× at loadavg 0.15, then read `1` for `0` once on run 35790429797 (a doc-comment-only tip) — the close was not back before the next statement on a loaded runner. The same class N116 retired (an assertion that depends on the host's speed)
items.discussion: the integrator (Order 40 seal: CI green everywhere else; the job re-run); N116 (no assertion reads a clock — this one reads a race); P10 / Q1 (the fire-and-forget close and why the count is read unpolled); B271-class 'plant-proven' instruments
items.body: Options: (a) a BOUNDED re-read (≤ 50 ms, a few tries) only while the count is above baseline — a leaked descriptor stays leaked across it, so the plant (`1, 2, 7`) still reds, while a close that is merely late settles; the comment's worry (node's FileHandle finalizer closing a leaked fd during a poll) needs a measurement: the finalizer runs at GC, which a 50 ms window does not reach on a warm heap; (b) make the close synchronous at the statement end (a design change to Q1); (c) mark the pin as load-sensitive and skip it under `CI` with a note. Rec (a) with the finalizer window measured. Sizing S.
